lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the reviewer's WARNING against src/commands/stats.ts:148 (renderCyclesTable): cycleId is an OPAQUE free-form string (branch names) with no length ceiling and reached 47 chars in the committed artifact, colliding directly into the Issue column because String.padEnd only ever adds padding and never truncates a value already at or past the target width. Fixed with a new truncateForColumn(value, width) helper (value.length >= width ? value.slice(0, width - 1) : value) applied to cycleId before padEnd(CYCLE_COL_WIDTH), guaranteeing at least one separator column regardless of input length; issueNumber (fixed-shape CAM-NNN) was left untouched since it has an enforced short shape. Added a regression test in test/commands/stats-cycles.test.ts reproducing the exact 54-char collision example from the review finding (asserts the row no longer contains the collided substring and that a separator space precedes the issue column). This story only fixed the one WARNING finding; the review round's five SUGGESTIONs (c8-ignore pragma inertness in src/stats/cycles.ts:357, mergeMode widening via typeof-only check in src/stats/cycles.ts:188, silent unknown-flag handling in parseStatsArgs at index.ts:2270, no branch guard on --rebuild writing scripts/cam/cycle-metrics.jsonl off-main, and the missing README `cam stats` entry) were NOT addressed here -- they are non-blocking SUGGESTIONs, not the WARNING this fix-story exists for, and remain open for a future story/issue if the operator wants them actioned. Full quality spine (bun run check:all, all 10 ratchets) is green.
